violation_type.title: Documented annual training - Employee prior to accompanying a child to a swimming pool (26 TAC §746.1325(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Documented annual training - Employee prior to accompanying a child to a swimming pool
violation_type.typical_finding: Evidence gathered during this investigation shows a caregiver did not have water safety training prior to taking a group of children swimming.      The caregiver took the training after returning from the swimming field trip.

finding_variants.text: Evidence gathered during this investigation shows a caregiver did not have water safety training prior to taking a group of children swimming.      The caregiver took the training after returning from the swimming field trip.
At the time of the inspection, employees accompanying children at swimming pool did not have the required training.
Evidence gathered during this investigation shows the caregivers did not have the required water safety training prior to taking a group of children swimming at the city pool.
